message: Walk in the glow of the Shadow, my child. Unfortunately, if you've come to me sick or with a stomach ache, I don't have any bonemeal potions for healing anymore, only those ineffective regular potions.

replies.text: Show me what you have to trade.
Do you have anything else for food poisoning?
What can you tell me about bonemeal?

message: We shouldn't talk about that. Lord Geomyr issued a decree. It's not allowed anymore.
No, sorry. I hear that the potion-maker in Fallhaven can create something to help against that though.
